title: Who Works Here?
description: The login page answers differently depending on who you ask about. Find the hidden internal account and read what its response gives away.

title: Lost Password
description: The password reset form is too helpful. Identify the hidden recovery account and collect its ticket reference.

title: Somebody Else’s Order
description: Orders and invoices belong to customers, but does the server check? Find the order with the objective data in its gift message.

title: Zombie Session
description: Log out, change your password, then see whether your old session still has a pulse.

title: Promote Yourself
description: Update your own profile and see what else the server is willing to accept. Then visit the admin overview.

title: Delivery Notes
description: Addresses are fetched by user id. Read the delivery notes on another user’s Office address.

title: Echo Chamber
description: The legacy search page repeats what you give it. Make it run your script and read the cookie.

title: Poisoned Review
description: Leave a product review that fires for every visitor and read the cookie.

title: Hash Fragment
description: The flash sale page trusts its own URL. The server never sees your payload, so look at the client code.

title: Search Is Hungry
description: Only one search parameter reaches the database unsafely. Find it and pull data from the hidden table.

title: Public Key, Private Door
description: The server publishes its public key. Persuade it to treat that key as something else and open the vault.

title: Halfway There
description: Stop at the OTP step and see which endpoints still answer to your partial token.
